none: PAS NLM-A638A9: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), probably a fallen horseman issue of 355-361, possibly Lyon mint, Reece period 18. Obverse description: Head diademed right. Obverse inscription: [----]AVG. Reverse description: probably soldier advancing left spearing fallen horseman. Reverse inscription: probably [FEL TEMP REPARATIO]. In exergue: OPLG.
